verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל כָּל־ הָ֨עֵדָ֤ה מִדְבַּר־ צִן֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב הָעָ֖ם בְּקָדֵ֑שׁ וַתָּ֤מָת שָׁם֙ מִרְיָ֔ם וַתִּקָּבֵ֖ר שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh miḏ·bar- ṣin ba·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn way·yê·šeḇ hā·‘ām bə·qā·ḏêš wat·tā·māṯ šām mir·yām wat·tiq·qā·ḇêr šām
verses.literal: In the first month the whole congregation . . . of Israel entered the Wilderness of Zin and stayed in Kadesh There Miriam died and was buried . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel, a congregação toda, vieram ao deserto de Zim, no primeiro mês. Ficou o povo em Cades; ali, morreu Miriã e ali foi sepultada.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ הָ֥יָה מַ֖יִם לָעֵדָ֑ה וַיִּקָּ֣הֲל֔וּ עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְעַֽל־ אַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- hā·yāh ma·yim lā·‘ê·ḏāh way·yiq·qā·hă·lū ‘al- mō·šeh wə·‘al- ’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: Now there was no water for the congregation so they gathered against Moses . . . and Aaron
verses.literalPt: Não havia água para a congregação; e ajuntaram-se contra Moisés e contra Arão.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥רֶב הָעָ֖ם עִם־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לֵאמֹ֔ר וְל֥וּ גָוַ֛עְנוּ בִּגְוַ֥ע אַחֵ֖ינוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·reḇ hā·‘ām ‘im- mō·šeh way·yō·mə·rū lê·mōr wə·lū ḡā·wa‘·nū biḡ·wa‘ ’a·ḥê·nū lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The people quarreled with Moses and said . . . If only we had perished . . . with our brothers before the LORD
verses.literalPt: O povo contendeu com Moisés, dizendo: Oxalá que tivéssemos perecido, quando pereceram os nossos irmãos diante de Jeová!

verses.original: וְלָמָ֤ה הֲבֵאתֶם֙ אֶת־ קְהַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה לָמ֣וּת שָׁ֔ם אֲנַ֖חְנוּ וּבְעִירֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·māh hă·ḇê·ṯem ’eṯ- qə·hal Yah·weh ’el- ham·miḏ·bār haz·zeh lā·mūṯ šām ’ă·naḥ·nū ū·ḇə·‘î·rê·nū
verses.literal: Why have you brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness for us and our livestock to die here
verses.literalPt: Por que introduzistes a assembleia de Jeová neste deserto, para aí morrermos, assim nós como os nossos animais?

verses.original: וְלָמָ֤ה הֶֽעֱלִיתֻ֙נוּ֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם לְהָבִ֣יא אֹתָ֔נוּ אֶל־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הָרָ֖ע הַזֶּ֑ה לֹ֣א׀ מְק֣וֹם זֶ֗רַע וּתְאֵנָ֤ה וְגֶ֙פֶן֙ וְרִמּ֔וֹן וּמַ֥יִם אַ֖יִן לִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·māh he·‘ĕ·lî·ṯu·nū mim·miṣ·ra·yim lə·hā·ḇî ’ō·ṯā·nū ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm hā·rā‘ haz·zeh lō mə·qō·wm ze·ra‘ ū·ṯə·’ê·nāh wə·ḡe·p̄en wə·rim·mō·wn ū·ma·yim ’a·yin liš·tō·wṯ
verses.literal: Why have you led us up out of Egypt to bring us to this wretched place It is not a place of grain figs vines or pomegranates and there is no water to drink
verses.literalPt: Por que nos fizestes subir do Egito, para nos introduzir neste mau lugar? Não é lugar de semente, nem de figos, nem de vides, nem de romãs; nem tampouco há água para beber.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאַהֲרֹ֜ן מִפְּנֵ֣י הַקָּהָ֗ל אֶל־ פֶּ֙תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֵּרָ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn mip·pə·nê haq·qā·hāl ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ way·yip·pə·lū ‘al- pə·nê·hem way·yê·rā ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting They fell facedown . . . . . . and the glory of the LORD appeared to them
verses.literalPt: Retirando-se Moisés e Arão da presença da assembleia para a entrada da tenda da revelação, prostraram-se com o rosto em terra; e a glória de Jeová lhes apareceu.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: קַ֣ח אֶת־ הַמַּטֶּ֗ה וְהַקְהֵ֤ל אֶת־ הָעֵדָה֙ אַתָּה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֔יךָ וְדִבַּרְתֶּ֧ם אֶל־ הַסֶּ֛לַע לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם וְנָתַ֣ן מֵימָ֑יו וְהוֹצֵאתָ֨ לָהֶ֥ם מַ֙יִם֙ מִן־ הַסֶּ֔לַע וְהִשְׁקִיתָ֥ אֶת־ הָעֵדָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בְּעִירָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: qaḥ ’eṯ- ham·maṭ·ṭeh wə·haq·hêl ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḏāh ’at·tāh wə·’a·hă·rōn ’ā·ḥî·ḵā wə·ḏib·bar·tem ’el- has·se·la‘ lə·‘ê·nê·hem wə·nā·ṯan mê·māw wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯā lā·hem ma·yim min- has·se·la‘ wə·hiš·qî·ṯā ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- bə·‘î·rām
verses.literal: Take the staff and assemble the congregation You and your brother Aaron are to speak to the rock while they watch and it will pour out its water You will bring out water from the rock and provide drink for the congregation and their livestock
verses.literalPt: Toma a vara e ajunta a congregação, tu, e Arão, teu irmão, e falai à rocha diante deles que dê as suas águas. Far-lhes-ás sair água da rocha; assim, darás de beber à congregação e aos seus animais.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ הַמַּטֶּ֖ה מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mō·šeh ’eṯ- ham·maṭ·ṭeh mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wā·hū
verses.literal: So Moses took the staff from the LORD’s presence just as he had been commanded
verses.literalPt: Então, tomou Moisés a vara de diante de Jeová, como lhe ordenou.

verses.original: וַיַּקְהִ֜לוּ מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־ הַקָּהָ֖ל אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַסָּ֑לַע וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם שִׁמְעוּ־ נָא֙ הַמֹּרִ֔ים הֲמִן־ הַסֶּ֣לַע הַזֶּ֔ה נוֹצִ֥יא לָכֶ֖ם מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·hi·lū mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- haq·qā·hāl ’el- pə·nê has·sā·la‘ way·yō·mer lā·hem šim·‘ū- nā ham·mō·rîm hă·min- has·se·la‘ haz·zeh nō·w·ṣî lā·ḵem mā·yim
verses.literal: Then Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly in front of the rock and Moses said to them Listen now you rebels must we bring you water out of this rock
verses.literalPt: Moisés e Arão reuniram a assembleia diante da rocha, e Moisés disse-lhes: Ouvi, pois, rebeldes; havemos de fazer sair água desta rocha para vós?

verses.original: וַיָּ֨רֶם מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ יָד֗וֹ וַיַּ֧ךְ אֶת־ הַסֶּ֛לַע בְּמַטֵּ֖הוּ פַּעֲמָ֑יִם וַיֵּצְאוּ֙ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים וַתֵּ֥שְׁתְּ הָעֵדָ֖ה וּבְעִירָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rem mō·šeh ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw way·yaḵ ’eṯ- has·se·la‘ bə·maṭ·ṭê·hū pa·‘ă·mā·yim way·yê·ṣə·’ū ma·yim rab·bîm wat·tê·šət hā·‘ê·ḏāh ū·ḇə·‘î·rām
verses.literal: Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff so that a great amount of water gushed out and the congregation and their livestock were able to drink
verses.literalPt: Moisés levantou a mão e feriu a rocha duas vezes com a sua vara; saíram águas copiosamente, e bebeu a congregação, e os seus animais.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֒ יַ֚עַן לֹא־ הֶאֱמַנְתֶּ֣ם בִּ֔י לְהַ֨קְדִּישֵׁ֔נִי לְעֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָכֵ֗ן לֹ֤א תָבִ֙יאוּ֙ אֶת־ הַקָּהָ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תִּי לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn ya·‘an lō- he·’ĕ·man·tem bî lə·haq·dî·šê·nî lə·‘ê·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lā·ḵên lō ṯā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- haq·qā·hāl haz·zeh ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem
verses.literal: But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron Because you did not trust Me to show My holiness in the sight of the Israelites . . . you will not bring this . . . assembly into the land that I have given them
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés e a Arão: Porque que não crestes em mim, para me santificardes aos olhos dos filhos de Israel, portanto, não introduzireis esta assembleia na terra que lhes dei.

verses.original: הֵ֚מָּה מֵ֣י מְרִיבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ רָב֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּקָּדֵ֖שׁ בָּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh mê mə·rî·ḇāh ’ă·šer- rā·ḇū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·yiq·qā·ḏêš bām
verses.literal: These were the waters of Meribah where the Israelites . . . quarreled with the LORD and He showed His holiness among them
verses.literalPt: Estas são as águas de Meribá, porque os filhos de Israel contenderam com Jeová, e neles foi santificado.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֧ה מַלְאָכִ֛ים מִקָּדֵ֖שׁ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֱד֑וֹם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אָחִ֣יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתָּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַתְּלָאָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מְצָאָֽתְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ mō·šeh mal·’ā·ḵîm miq·qā·ḏêš ’el- me·leḵ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm kōh ’ā·mar ’ā·ḥî·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā ’êṯ kāl- hat·tə·lā·’āh ’ă·šer mə·ṣā·’ā·ṯə·nū
verses.literal: From Kadesh Moses sent messengers to tell the king of Edom This is what your brother Israel says You know all the hardship that has befallen us
verses.literalPt: Moisés enviou de Cades embaixadores ao rei de Edom a dizer-lhe: Assim diz teu irmão Israel: Tu bem sabes todo o trabalho que nos tem sobrevindo;

verses.original: וַיֵּרְד֤וּ אֲבֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה וַנֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַיָּרֵ֥עוּ לָ֛נוּ מִצְרַ֖יִם וְלַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rə·ḏū ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū miṣ·ray·māh wan·nê·šeḇ bə·miṣ·ra·yim yā·mîm rab·bîm way·yā·rê·‘ū lā·nū miṣ·ra·yim wə·la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: how our fathers went down to Egypt where we lived many years The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers
verses.literalPt: como nossos pais desceram ao Egito, e habitamos ali muito tempo. Os egípcios nos maltrataram a nós e a nossos pais.

verses.original: וַנִּצְעַ֤ק אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע קֹלֵ֔נוּ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאָ֔ךְ וַיֹּצִאֵ֖נוּ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וְהִנֵּה֙ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ בְקָדֵ֔שׁ עִ֖יר קְצֵ֥ה גְבוּלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wan·niṣ·‘aq ’el- Yah·weh way·yiš·ma‘ qō·lê·nū way·yiš·laḥ mal·’āḵ way·yō·ṣi·’ê·nū mim·miṣ·rā·yim wə·hin·nêh ’ă·naḥ·nū ḇə·qā·ḏêš ‘îr qə·ṣêh ḡə·ḇū·le·ḵā
verses.literal: and when we cried out to the LORD He heard our voice sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt Now look we are in Kadesh a city on the edge of your territory
verses.literalPt: E, quando clamamos a Jeová, ele nos ouviu, enviou um anjo que nos tirou do Egito; eis que estamos em Cades, cidade na extremidade do teu território.

verses.original: נַעְבְּרָה־ נָּ֣א בְאַרְצֶ֗ךָ לֹ֤א נַעֲבֹר֙ בְּשָׂדֶ֣ה וּבְכֶ֔רֶם וְלֹ֥א נִשְׁתֶּ֖ה מֵ֣י בְאֵ֑ר דֶּ֧רֶךְ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ נֵלֵ֗ךְ לֹ֤א נִטֶּה֙ יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֔אול עַ֥ד אֲשֶֽׁר־ נַעֲבֹ֖ר גְּבוּלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: na‘·bə·rāh- nā ḇə·’ar·ṣe·ḵā lō na·‘ă·ḇōr bə·śā·ḏeh ū·ḇə·ḵe·rem wə·lō niš·teh mê ḇə·’êr de·reḵ ham·me·leḵ nê·lêḵ lō niṭ·ṭeh yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- na·‘ă·ḇōr gə·ḇū·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Please let us pass through your land We will not go through any field or vineyard or drink water from any well We will stay on the King’s Highway we will not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory
verses.literalPt: Deixa-nos passar pela tua terra; não passaremos pelos campos, nem pelas vinhas, nem beberemos a água dos poços; iremos pela estrada real, não nos desviaremos para a direita nem para a esquerda, até que tenhamos passado além do teu território.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אֱד֔וֹם לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר בִּ֑י פֶּן־ בַּחֶ֖רֶב אֵצֵ֥א לִקְרָאתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ĕ·ḏō·wm lō ṯa·‘ă·ḇōr bî pen- ba·ḥe·reḇ ’ê·ṣê liq·rā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: But Edom answered . . . You may not travel through our land or we will come out and confront you with the sword
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Edom: Não passarás por mim; não suceda sair eu ao teu encontro com a espada.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֥יו בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל בַּֽמְסִלָּ֣ה נַעֲלֶה֒ וְאִם־ מֵימֶ֤יךָ נִשְׁתֶּה֙ אֲנִ֣י וּמִקְנַ֔י וְנָתַתִּ֖י מִכְרָ֑ם רַ֥ק אֵין־ דָּבָ֖ר בְּרַגְלַ֥י אֶֽעֱבֹֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw bə·nê- yiś·rå̄·ʾēl bam·sil·lāh na·‘ă·leh wə·’im- mê·me·ḵā niš·teh ’ă·nî ū·miq·nay wə·nā·ṯat·tî miḵ·rām raq ’ên- dā·ḇār bə·raḡ·lay ’e·‘ĕ·ḇō·rāh
verses.literal: We will stay on the main road the Israelites . . . replied and if we or our herds drink your water we will pay for it There will be no problem only let us pass through on foot
verses.literalPt: Replicaram-lhe os filhos de Israel: Subiremos pela estrada real; se bebermos as tuas águas, eu e os meus animais, darei o preço delas; não desejo outra coisa senão passar a pé.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א תַעֲבֹ֑ר וַיֵּצֵ֤א אֱדוֹם֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ בְּעַ֥ם כָּבֵ֖ד וּבְיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lō ṯa·‘ă·ḇōr way·yê·ṣê ’ĕ·ḏō·wm liq·rā·ṯōw bə·‘am kā·ḇêḏ ū·ḇə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh
verses.literal: But Edom insisted You may not pass through And they came out to confront the Israelites with a large army and a strong hand
verses.literalPt: Respondeu ele: Não passarás. Saiu-lhe Edom ao encontro com muita gente e com mão forte.

verses.original: וַיְמָאֵ֣ן׀ אֱד֗וֹם נְתֹן֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֲבֹ֖ר בִּגְבֻל֑וֹ וַיֵּ֥ט יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵעָלָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·mā·’ên ’ĕ·ḏō·wm nə·ṯōn ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ă·ḇōr biḡ·ḇu·lōw way·yêṭ yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: So Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through their territory and Israel turned away from them
verses.literalPt: Assim, recusou Edom deixar passar Israel pelo seu território; pelo que Israel se desviou dele.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקָּדֵ֑שׁ וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה הֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū miq·qā·ḏêš way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh hōr hā·hār
verses.literal: After they had set out from Kadesh the whole congregation . . . of Israel came to Mount Hor
verses.literalPt: Então, partiram de Cades; e os filhos de Israel, a congregação toda, foram ao monte Hor.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן בְּהֹ֣ר הָהָ֑ר עַל־ גְּב֥וּל אֶֽרֶץ־ אֱד֖וֹם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn bə·hōr hā·hār ‘al- gə·ḇūl ’e·reṣ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm lê·mōr
verses.literal: And at Mount Hor near the border of the land of Edom the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés e a Arão no monte Hor, nos confins da terra de Edom:

verses.original: יֵאָסֵ֤ף אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־ עַמָּ֔יו כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָבֹא֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ מְרִיתֶ֥ם אֶת־ פִּ֖י לְמֵ֥י מְרִיבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yê·’ā·sêp̄ ’a·hă·rōn ’el- ‘am·māw kî lō yā·ḇō ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘al ’ă·šer- mə·rî·ṯem ’eṯ- pî lə·mê mə·rî·ḇāh
verses.literal: Aaron will be gathered to his people . . . he will not enter . . . the land that I have given the Israelites . . . because both of you rebelled against My command at the waters of Meribah
verses.literalPt: Arão será recolhido ao seu povo, pois não entrará na terra que dei aos filhos de Israel, porque fostes rebeldes contra a minha ordem às águas de Meribá.

verses.original: קַ֚ח אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְאֶת־ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר בְּנ֑וֹ וְהַ֥עַל אֹתָ֖ם הֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: qaḥ ’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’eṯ- ’el·‘ā·zār bə·nōw wə·ha·‘al ’ō·ṯām hōr hā·hār
verses.literal: Take Aaron and his son Eleazar and bring them up Mount Hor
verses.literalPt: Toma a Arão e a Eleazar, seu filho, e faze-os subir o monte Hor;

verses.original: וְהַפְשֵׁ֤ט אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֔יו וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֖ם אֶת־ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בְּנ֑וֹ וְאַהֲרֹ֥ן יֵאָסֵ֖ף וּמֵ֥ת שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hap̄·šêṭ ’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·hil·baš·tām ’eṯ- ’el·‘ā·zār bə·nōw wə·’a·hă·rōn yê·’ā·sêp̄ ū·mêṯ šām
verses.literal: Remove Aaron’s priestly garments and put them on his son Eleazar Aaron will be gathered to his people and will die there
verses.literalPt: depois de despir dos seus vestidos a Arão, veste-as a Eleazar, seu filho; Arão será recolhido ao seu povo e morrerá ali.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וַֽיַּעֲלוּ֙ אֶל־ הֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś mō·šeh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh way·ya·‘ă·lū ’el- hōr hā·hār lə·‘ê·nê kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded and they climbed . . . Mount Hor in the sight of the whole congregation
verses.literalPt: Fez Moisés como Jeová ordenou; e subiram ao monte Hor, à vista da congregação toda.

verses.original: וַיַּפְשֵׁט֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֗יו וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתָם֙ אֶת־ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בְּנ֔וֹ וַיָּ֧מָת אַהֲרֹ֛ן שָׁ֖ם בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר וַיֵּ֧רֶד מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר מִן־ הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yap̄·šêṭ mō·šeh ’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw way·yal·bêš ’ō·ṯām ’eṯ- ’el·‘ā·zār bə·nōw way·yā·māṯ ’a·hă·rōn šām bə·rōš hā·hār way·yê·reḏ mō·šeh wə·’el·‘ā·zār min- hā·hār
verses.literal: After Moses had removed Aaron’s garments and put them on . . . his son Eleazar Aaron died there on top of the mountain Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain
verses.literalPt: Moisés despiu a Arão dos vestidos e vestiu com eles a Eleazar, o filho; Arão morreu ali no cume do monte, e Moisés e Eleazar desceram do monte.

verses.original: וַיִּרְאוּ֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה כִּ֥י גָוַ֖ע אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיִּבְכּ֤וּ אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים י֔וֹם כֹּ֖ל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh kî ḡā·wa‘ ’a·hă·rōn way·yiḇ·kū ’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn šə·lō·šîm yō·wm kōl bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: When the whole congregation saw that Aaron had died the entire house of Israel mourned for him thirty days
verses.literalPt: Vendo toda a congregação que Arão era morto, chorou toda a casa de Israel a Arão, por trinta dias.
